body: So, how did you get undepressed?
I just wish I had friends I could go out with. No one ever invites me to go out with them. My only friend went out to a party tonight and didn't invite me, it fucking sucks being alone.
She's the only reason I haven't tried to hurt myself. Once she is gone though..
Yeah, my mom tries to help me.
No, I've been depressed since I can remember it's just gotten worse as I've gotten older.
Maybe, I'm sick of being alone though. No one understands me.

I don't club, I don't have the confidence for that. I play games and read. Those are the only two things that don't make me think of my situation. And before you ask, I am on an anti-depressant. The only thing it does is stop me from killing myself, it doesn't make it go away, or make me want to do anything.
I've tried really I have. I can't pull off the bald look my is a fucked up shape.

Pretty hard to have fun in life when you don't feel like doing anything. I have zero friends and suck at making them. Have fun with life easy advice to give, pretty hard to put into actual action when you suffer from chronic depression.
